title: [PTRun][Calculator] Persist copied results without a post-write OLE flush

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The latest diagnostic invoked CsWinRT once and recorded child exit -1073740791 with MSB3073, although MSBuild converted the failure into a warning and exited zero. The attempt did not establish a valid exact-root discriminator: a command-line trailing-separator quoting error redirected response output to a sibling path, while the intended response remained stale. No downstream build or test ran, and the lock was released. A private response-file route now avoids overriding the output-directory property and adds evaluated-root assertions before cleanup and generation; that corrected route still requires execution. The original projection failure remains unresolved.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
